import pytest
from your_module import lru_cache  # Replace `your_module` with the actual module name

class TestLRUCache:
    """Unit tests for the lru_cache function."""

    # --- Happy Path ---

    def test_basic_put_and_get(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 1)
        put(2, 2)
        assert get(1) == 1
        assert get(2) == 2

    def test_eviction_when_capacity_exceeded(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 1)
        put(2, 2)
        put(3, 3)  # 1 is LRU, should be evicted
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == 2
        assert get(3) == 3

    def test_update_existing_key(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 1)
        put(2, 2)
        put(1, 10)  # update key 1
        assert get(1) == 10
        assert get(2) == 2
        # 2 is now LRU
        put(3, 3)
        assert get(2) == -1
        assert get(1) == 10
        assert get(3) == 3

    def test_get_moves_key_to_mru(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 1)
        put(2, 2)
        get(1)  # makes 1 most recently used
        put(3, 3)  # should evict 2
        assert get(2) == -1
        assert get(1) == 1
        assert get(3) == 3

    # --- Edge Cases ---

    def test_capacity_zero(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(0)
        put(1, 1)
        assert get(1) == -1  # cached then immediately evicted

    def test_capacity_one(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(1)
        put(1, 1)
        assert get(1) == 1
        put(2, 2)  # evicts 1
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == 2

    def test_capacity_one_update_does_not_evict_self(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(1)
        put(1, 1)
        put(1, 2)  # update, no eviction
        assert get(1) == 2

    def test_large_capacity(self):
        n = 1000
        get, put = lru_cache(n)
        for i in range(n):
            put(i, i)
        # All items should be present
        for i in range(n):
            assert get(i) == i
        # Insert one more to trigger eviction of the LRU (0)
        put(n, n)
        assert get(0) == -1
        assert get(1) == 1
        assert get(n) == n

    def test_get_nonexistent_key(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        assert get(99) == -1
        put(1, 1)
        assert get(2) == -1

    def test_overwrite_does_not_evict_other_keys(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 1)
        put(2, 2)
        put(1, 10)  # overwrite
        assert get(1) == 10
        assert get(2) == 2
        # No eviction happened, capacity still 2
        put(3, 3)
        assert get(2) == -1  # 2 was LRU

    def test_negative_capacity(self):
        """negative capacity: len(cache) > capacity is always True → immediate eviction."""
        get, put = lru_cache(-1)
        put(1, 1)
        assert get(1) == -1
        put(2, 2)
        assert get(2) == -1

    # --- Error Cases ---

    def test_non_integer_capacity_raises_on_put(self):
        """Passing a non-integer capacity defers the error until a put call."""
        get, put = lru_cache("two")
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            put(1, 1)

    def test_unhashable_key_raises_on_put(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            put([1, 2], "value")

    def test_unhashable_key_raises_on_get(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            get([1, 2])
